items.a: No. We'll make one hoodie or two hundred jerseys. Per-unit pricing does drop as quantity rises, so we'll show you the breaks in your quote and you can decide where to land.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Fill in the [quote request form](/request-a-quote) with your sport, the garments you're after, rough numbers and when you need it. You'll get a written price and a free design mockup back within one business day. If you'd rather talk it through, call us and we'll work it out with you on the phone.

items.q: Does a quote lock me in?
items.a: No. A quote is free and carries no obligation. Nothing goes into production until you've approved your final mockup and paid a deposit.

items.q: Can we add players after we've ordered?
items.a: Yes. Because there's no minimum order and your design stays on file, a late signing is a single extra garment on a quick reorder. We match the colours to your original run.
